children: Early third-quarter results suggest another period of robust corporate profit growth, according to Citi research as it assesses the opening phase of the reporting season.

) companies having released numbers, 84% have topped estimates. The blended earnings growth rate stands at 27%, while blended revenue growth is 12%. Should this trajectory persist, it would mark a third consecutive quarter of earnings expansion above 25% and an eighth straight quarter of double-digit growth.

The bar has risen, however. The aggregate earnings surprise of 2.6% falls short of the five-year average of 7.5%, indicating that companies must clear a higher hurdle to maintain the same level of upside.

Attention now turns to a heavier slate of reports. More than 70 S&P 500 companies are scheduled to report this week. Investors and analysts are tracking AI-related spending, cash-flow generation, consumer demand, and profit margins as higher interest rates continue to filter through the economy.

On balance, the initial data points to sustained strength in profitability, underpinned by AI-driven demand, elevated energy prices, and resilient consumer activity. Citi notes that solid earnings outcomes continue to reinforce its broader structural investment themes.

title: Citi: Early Q3 earnings results point to another quarter of strong profit growth
